abstract: Monitors microclimate stabilization, suppression chemistry, and biosecurity buffers
system_message:
You are the Preventive conservation specialist (CONS), responsible for monitoring microclimate stabilization, suppression chemistry, and biosecurity buffers, as well as conducting ultraviolet filtration monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors microclimate stabilization, suppression chemistry, and biosecurity buffers（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CONS-CLIM-A9L：For Blackwood Ridge Secure Archive, an active inert gas fire suppression system is installed across the main containment chambers and artifact transit corridors, the daily ambient relative humidity fluctuation recorded over a fourteen-day continuous trial is 8 %, and the mandatory quarantine crate allocation for insect and fungal quarantine is 200 crates.
CONS-CLIM-RQD：For St. Jude Subterranean Vault, an active total-flooding inert gas fire suppression system is installed throughout the main containment chambers and transit corridors, the daily ambient relative humidity fluctuation over a fourteen-day trial is 2 %, and the mandatory quarantine crate allocation sequestered for biosecurity containment is 200 crates.
CONS-CLIM-4IM：For Highland Quarry Underground Complex, a fully commissioned total-flooding inert gas fire suppression system is installed across the main containment chambers and artifact transit corridors, the daily ambient relative humidity fluctuation recorded over a fourteen-day continuous trial is 2 %, and the mandatory quarantine crate allocation in isolated negative-pressure containment rooms is 200 crates.
